h: Video of the Ooni of Ife standing to greet billionaire Obi Jackson sparks uproar online
p: A video of the Ooni of Ife rising to greet businessman Obi Jackson has gone viral and divided Nigerians online. Some say it was a simple courtesy, while others question the protocol for a monarch of his stature.
more: Reactions are split between praise for the gesture and criticism of it.
The palace has not issued a statement on the clip.
